'No shift' days.description: Refers to calendar days when no shift is planned — meaning the factory or line is not scheduled to operate. Useful for planning downtime or maintenance days.

Added.description: Notification to the user that a report has been sucessfully added.

Advanced settings.description: Headline in the Settings blocks where advanced settings are placed.

After.description: A UI chip showing a selection.

Alert.description: Heading of a modal where user can set the details to receive alert messages.

Authentication.description: Heading of a column, where the values are either ON or OFF - meaning that authentication is either required or not.

availability.description: OEE component measuring equipment uptime versus planned production time.

Average.description: Mathematical mean or typical value calculation.

Brave browser detected.description: System announces that the user is accessing the application using the Brave web browser.

By changing the group, following station.description: Notification to the user when they change a group containing for example stop reasons, that related stations are also updated.

Can't scan the QR code?.description: This is a prompt for users who might be experiencing difficulty in scanning the QR code with their authenticator app. This could be due to technical issues or a lack of understanding of the process.

Cancel.description: UI call to action button that cancels an operation.

Change password.description: Option for a user to change their password under their profile settings.

Change to production.description: The phrase is a UI button used in manufacturing/OEE software to reclassify a time period from downtime (non-productive) to production time (productive). It should be translated as a short, action-oriented command suitable for a software interface—like a button label—clearly conveying that the user is converting time into productive or running time. Avoid overly literal translations; use the most natural and intuitive phrasing in your language that reflects this meaning in a manufacturing context

Changeover.description: Noun. Refers to a point in time when a production line operators finishes producing one product and changes over to another one.

Channel.description: A channel to send messages to

Checklist.description: Text on a button from where user can add checklists.

Checklists.description: Feature for managing routine production checks (quality, maintenance, security, etc.).

Completed batches.description: Shows a history or list of batches where the production process has been successfully finished and closed.

Conditions.description: Title for the section that describes when an alert should be sent.

Confirmation.description: Indicates the confirmation modal for removing/deleting anything.

connected station.description: After that comes the name of the station that is connected to a specific product.

Continue.description: A single-word action button or label used to proceed to the next step.

Daily.description: Frequency option for events that occur each day but not necessarily every day.

Days.description: Time unit label for day measurements.

daysGenitive.description: Used as a time unit after numerals ≥2. System supports only singular vs plural. Choose the most natural plural form for general numeric use. Do not translate into multiple words, even if this would be 100% correct. This phrase always goes at end of a sentence.

default.description: Standard or preset value that applies automatically.

Weeks.description: Refers to a unit of time interval (plural of 'week') used in scheduling. In this UI, it indicates how often something repeats — for example, 'repeat every 2 weeks'. It should be translated as the measure of time, not as 'work week' or 'calendar week,' but simply the duration of 7 days.

What has to be checked?.description: Free text field for the user to describe what has to be checked during the check (visual check, for example color or shape).

What has to be measured?.description: Free text field for the user to describe what has to be measured during the check

What's new.description: Menu item from where the user can see what updates have been done recently

When enabled operators must choose locat.description: Informative text to user regarding compulsory location selection option.

When enabled operators must enter an ext.description: Explanatory text for a user, explaining how to use "required extra note" feature. This feature means that when it is enabled, operators must add a free text extra note to a stop reason (when they add it to a production stop in Shift View).

When enabled this reason will be used to.description: Explanatory text for a user, explaining how to use "technical availability" feature for stop reasons. This feature, when enabled for a stop reason, means that this stop reason is included in the technical availability calculation. Used mostly on stop reasons for technical issues.

When enabled, operators can add multiple.description: Switch help text for YES/NO checklist tasks that describes an option to allow multiple answers
Switch that describes an option to allow multiple entries to a input field

When enabled, operators can mark this ta.description: Explanatory text for enabling "Not applicable" option for operators.

When enabled, this reason will add scrap.description: This is a help sentence aimed at helping users understand what a feature does.

When enabled, this stop reason will redu.description: Informative text for the user, explaining that when this option is enabled, the specific stop reason is included in the OEE calculations.

Where is this produced?.description: This is used as a heading. Refers to the block under product settings where admin user can define specific settings for a product on a specific station. For example, one product can be produced on several stations, but the production speed could be different.

Who should receive messages from this st.description: Instructive text for the user to enter contacts who should receive messanges that operators can send from the Shift View.

Whole period.description: Indicating that comparison of a period is made with a whole preceding period, not a matching period.

Wifi.description: Refers to a devices WiFi network MAC address

Wrong code. Please try again..description: Authentication error message for incorrect factory access code.

X-axis.description: Refers to the x-axis of a graph (horizontal axis)

Y-axis.description: Refers to the y-axis of a graph (vertical axis)

Yes.description: Text on a button for confirmation (e.g. deleting confirmation).

You are about to exit without saving cha.description: Notification to the user when they have made changes, but have not clicked Save-button before exiting.

You are about to save the product withou.description: Notification for the user regarding saving product details but not specifying any stations this product would be produced on.

You are about to share your dashboard. T.description: Confirmation before the user can proceed.

You are in read-only mode.description: System message indicating the user can only view data but cannot make changes or edits.

You can move stations between groups by.description: Instructive text in case of an empty station group.

You can send messages to e-mails defined.description: Instructive text, explaining to the user that the messages from the workstation can be sent to e-mail adresses that have been defined in the settings of the same workstation.

You don’t have permission to manage glob.description: Informative notification for users that don't have permissions to change groups that have been set as global. They can change groups that are set as local.

You will be directed to current shift in.description: Automatic redirect message with countdown timer. {count} is placeholder for seconds remaining.

You will be redirected to live view in {.description: Notification to the user that they are being redirected to another view in the system.

Your email does not contain {at}evocon,.description: The user must enter a username and email address that uses the same domain. If these do not match, the user will be notified to change the username.

Your report is being prepared and will b.description: Letting the user know that they might need to wait a bit before they will get the download link. Full setnance: Your report is being prepared and will be sent with download instructions. Larger reports may take longer.’

Your selected filters and chart options.description: This warning appears when a user selects filters and chart settings that generate a very large dataset in a reporting dashboard. It alerts them that the page may slow down or freeze. Keep the tone clear and professional, not alarming. "Filters" and "chart options" refer to user-selected data and display settings.
